workflow: A caller supplies a size value larger than the downstream component’s supported signed range.
The interface accepts the oversized value without validating it against that narrower range.
The downstream component performs internal arithmetic or conversion with the invalid size, causing integer overflow and corrupting its screen state.
A later refresh uses the corrupted state and dereferences invalid memory, terminating the process instead of returning a range error.
summary: Unchecked oversized dimensions cause downstream integer overflow and refresh crash
